settings.title: WhatsApp
settings.description: Send and receive WhatsApp messages with your customers.

enable.label: Enable WhatsApp
enable.hint: Turn on once your provider credentials are in place.
enable.disabledInfo: Switch WhatsApp on to set up your provider, number and template.

provider.label: Provider
provider.hint: Who supplies your WhatsApp number. Switching keeps the credentials of the old one.

from.label: Your WhatsApp number
from.hint: The business number customers see, in international format.

secret.stored: Saved and hidden. Type a new value to replace it.

webhook.label: Webhook URL
webhook.description: Paste this into your provider so incoming messages reach Torqvoice.
webhook.saveFirst: Save these settings before your provider verifies the URL. It is checked against what is stored here, so an unsaved form fails the check.

template.title: Message template
template.description: Used when you write to a customer who has not messaged you recently.
template.windowExplainer: WhatsApp only allows free text for 24 hours after the customer's last message. Outside that window your message has to go out as a template approved by your provider.
template.nameHint: The approved template's name, or its Content SID at providers that use one.
template.languageHint: The language code the template was approved under, for example de.
template.variablesHint: Pick the values that fill your template's numbered blanks, in the same order. Leave empty if your template has no blanks.
template.variablesEmpty: No values yet. Add them below, in the order your template expects.
template.mediaUrlHint: Paste this into the template's media field and replace n with the number of the photo value.
template.mediaUrlSample: For the provider's sample value, use: sample
template.textDescription: Used when you write with no photo attached: from Messages, from the WhatsApp tab on a customer, or from a scheduled message.
template.mediaDescription: Used by the Send on WhatsApp button on a job's photos, and whenever you attach a photo in a conversation.
template.textMissing: Not set up: you cannot write to a customer who has not messaged in the last 24 hours.
template.mediaMissing: Not set up: you cannot send photos to a customer who has not messaged in the last 24 hours.
template.whatIsIt: A template is a fixed message you write once and {provider} has approved: the wording never changes, only the numbered blanks you fill in. Write it in their console, then paste its identifier here.
template.whyTwo: Two are needed because WhatsApp fixes a template's media type when it approves it. One approved with a photo can only ever carry a photo, and one approved as text can never carry one.
template.exampleLabel: Example body to write in your provider's console
template.exampleTextValues: Fill it with: customer, message. Write it in the language your customers read.
template.exampleMediaValues: Fill it with: customer, message, and photo for the media URL. Write it in the language your customers read.

test.failed: Could not send the test message
test.hint: Message yourself on WhatsApp first, otherwise the test needs an approved template.

disconnect.hint: Removes the credentials from Torqvoice. Your conversations are kept.
disconnect.title: Disconnect

settings.savedIncomplete: Saved. Still needed before you can send: {fields}
settings.fieldStillNeeded: Still needed before you can send

provider.title: Choose your provider and number
provider.description: Twilio is quicker to start with and handles Meta for you. Meta Cloud API costs less but you complete its business verification yourself. Enter the number customers will see, in international format.

credentials.title: Enter your credentials
credentials.description: Copy each value from {provider}. Every field below says exactly where to find it. Save when you have them; you can come back for the rest.

webhook.title: Register the webhook
webhook.description: Copy this address into {provider} so messages from customers reach Torqvoice. Save this page first: the address is checked against what is stored here.
webhook.waiting: Nothing has reached this address yet. It turns green the moment your provider verifies it or delivers a message.
webhook.seen: Your provider has reached this address. Incoming messages will appear in Messages.

templates.title: Approve your templates
templates.description: Only needed to write first, outside the 24 hour window. You can skip this now and come back once messaging works.

test.title: Send a test message
test.description: Message your WhatsApp number from your own phone first. That proves the webhook works and opens a 24 hour window, so a reply needs no template.

register.title: Register the number with Meta
register.description: Meta needs a separate registration once the number is verified. Choose a six-digit PIN, or use the number's existing two-step verification PIN if it has one. Write it down: you need it to move or re-register the number later.
register.limit: Meta allows 10 registration attempts per number in 72 hours. A wrong PIN counts, so check it before pressing.

messages.featureDescription: Send and receive WhatsApp messages, including photos of parts, directly from Torqvoice.
messages.noThreadsHint: Messages appear here as soon as a customer writes to your WhatsApp number, or you write to them.
messages.sentAsTemplateNotice: Sent as your approved template, because the customer has not written in the last 24 hours.
messages.windowClosed: The customer has not written in the last 24 hours, so this will go out as your approved template.
messages.unknownNumber: This number belongs to no customer yet. Add them as a customer to reply.

notConfigured.title: WhatsApp is not connected
notConfigured.description: Connect a WhatsApp number to send and receive messages with your customers.

messages.title: Conversations

compose.title: New WhatsApp message
compose.noRecipients: No customers with a phone number yet.

messages.windowBlocked: This customer has not written in the last 24 hours, so WhatsApp will not deliver a message right now. Ask them to send you one, or set up an approved template.
messages.windowBlockedPlaceholder: Waiting for the customer to write first

sendPhoto.title: Send photo on WhatsApp
sendPhoto.description: The customer gets this photo in their WhatsApp chat.
sendPhoto.captionPlaceholder: Add a note, for example what the photo shows
sendPhoto.sentAsTemplate: Photo sent as your approved template
